text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That felt like a good time to me. My legs
are
really moving today!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You betcha-bet! And it's all thanks to
you,
Trainer. ♪
choice_data_list_en: Looks like you're in good shape!
You seem to be in good shape!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nuh-uh! Well, yeah, I'm the one doing
all the
running. But you do so much
too...
choice_data_list: いや、君の頑張りの成果だ
ううん、貴方の頑張りの成果だよ
choice_data_list_en: No, it's the fruit of your hard work.
No, it's the result of your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Man, this sucks. It's always right when
we're
winding down that my engines
start heating up...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What? No way! I wouldn't want to keep
you out.
It's already getting late.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, but you said it—not me,
remember?
Don't go regretting this!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Trainer. You sure you're good
with our
training session being this
early?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: 夕方はバイトなんだろう？
夕方はバイトなんでしょ？
choice_data_list_en: Don't you have a part-time job in the evening?
Don't you have a part-time job in the evening?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Remember all that? You've been
matching my
energy this whole time
we've been together,
right?
choice_data_list: だったら、今走っておこう！
choice_data_list_en: Then let's go for a run right now!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I think that's been a really big help!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Basically, I'm really grateful. You're
always
thinking about what's best for
me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Geez. You always act so humble! But I
guess...
choice_data_list: じゃあ、2人の成果ってことで
choice_data_list_en: Then let's call it an achievement for both of us.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If these results belong to both of us,
then that
means this happiness does too,
right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okie-dokie, then. Hehe, I like that idea.
